text:
Hello there,

The reason Feldegg Holdings gives for wanting more money from me is, in their words, that my rent is "below the level customary in Emmen". Full stop. Nothing about their costs going up, no word about mortgage rates or heating or maintenance, and they haven't renovated anything or added anything to the flat. I've lived at Talstrasse 26 since May 2024 and the kitchen is still the same tired one from the eighties.

It also isn't one of those agreements where the rent climbs in fixed steps every year. My lease has nothing like that, just the one monthly amount.

I'm sending you the e-mail in which Mr David Marti confirms the date the letter reached me, 26 March 2026.

So here is the situation: in that letter Feldegg tells me my rent will go up from CHF 1010 to CHF 1125 a month. That's more than CHF 1300 a year extra for a small two-room flat. I'm an apprentice electrician in my last year and my budget is already stretched. My girlfriend Kate Müller says I should challenge it, but I have no idea how that works or whether I've already missed my chance, since it's now May.

The increase notice itself is attached as well.

Thanks a lot for looking at this.

Jack Turner
